semiconductor_relevance: Medium — MADDE specializes in advanced 3D printing services using Silicon Carbide, which is relevant for semiconductor manufacturing but does not directly engage in traditional semiconductor production.
summary: MADDE Inc is a manufacturing services company that leverages advanced 3D printing technology to produce components using Silicon Carbide and metals. Their focus on Binder Jetting enables rapid and cost-effective production of complex shapes, particularly for wafer handling applications in high-tech industries.
